svg.title: Тяга широким хватом в Смите — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Wide-grip bent-over Smith-machine row. Draw a true Smith with two vertical guides and one horizontal bar mechanically connected via carriage sleeves to BOTH guides. Both feet planted; soft knees, same stable hip hinge with torso about 35 degrees above horizontal in both poses. Athlete uses a visibly wide overhand grip wider than shoulder width. Left: arms extend down to fixed rail-guided bar below knees. Right: same bent-over torso position and same knee angle, both elbows pull backward and outward, bar rises vertically along guides to lower ribs/upper abdomen. No standing upright, no deadlift, no free bar, no cable. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
